import.keepAwake: Keep the device awake and this window open until the import has finished.

dav.title: Address book on Mac and iPhone
dav.intro: With this password your iPhone shows your contacts' names when they call. It can only read.
dav.regenerateConfirm: The old password stops working at once. Afterwards, enter the new password on the Mac and the iPhone.
dav.shownOnce: Write the password down now or copy it straight into the settings. It is shown only once.
dav.revokeConfirm: Mac and iPhone can no longer load the address book. The contacts disappear at the next sync.

steps.title: How to set it up
steps.mac: On the Mac: System Settings → Internet Accounts → Add Account → Add Other Account → CardDAV account. Choose «Manual» and paste the user name, the password and the full server address including https://.
steps.iphone: On the iPhone: Settings → Apps → Contacts → Contacts Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add CardDAV Account. Paste the full server address including https://, then the user name and the password.

book.title: Address book status
book.empty: The address book has not been created yet.

dav.refreshDone: The address book is up to date. Mac and iPhone fetch the changes at their next sync.
dav.refreshTooSoon: The address book was just updated. Please try again in a few minutes.
dav.error: That did not work. Please try again.
